end.summary:
Practised levels of organisation using human and plant examples.
Yash gave 2 unaided correct example responses, including skin cells → tissue and heart → organ.
The order cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism was revisited several times.
The heart-versus-circulatory-system mix-up was clarified: the heart is one organ; together with blood vessels, it forms an organ system.
Teach-back was not passed by the end of the lesson.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the levels of organisation through examples and a team analogy. Yash explained that similar cells form a tissue and tissues form an organ; the heart-versus-circulatory-system mix-up was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Yash to arrange the five levels with one human example and one plant example for each.
